POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: extreme seasonal opposition AND extreme numerousness imbalance both present
COUNTEREVIDENCE: moderate imbalance only -> does not clear this precondition, routes to ORD- stage directly via SPECIAL-04 NONE_DETECTED

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.condition: AX09_fact.incompleteCount === true and the imbalance is borderline

DOES_NOT_IMPLY: oneSidednessDetected does not imply SPECIAL_PATTERN_STATUS = HIGH_CONFIDENCE — it only clears the precondition to run the compound test at SPECIAL-02/03

COUNTEREVIDENCE: DTS-CONGXIANG-01: 蟠根在未 (월지) + 餘氣在辰 (년지) — a real 월지 root exists, yet the chart still follows, because the compound test also requires an ABSENCE of outlet/protector for the surviving root to matter, and no outlet exists here to metabolize the surrounding 財 — this case is the reason the test is compound, not root-alone

INPUT_FACTS: AX02_fact (seasonal support of the resulting element)
REQUIRED_INFERENCES: RELATION_STRUCTURALLY_ACTIVE: the resulting element must have a further transparent root (元神透露) AND seasonal support; absence of either -> 假化
POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: resulting element has a transparent root AND seasonal support (真化)

UNCERTAINTY_EXIT.condition: combination glyph present but seasonal-support fact from FACT-04 is itself INSUFFICIENT (boundary birth)

DOES_NOT_IMPLY: FALSE_TRANSFORMATION does not imply the chart is ordinary-weak — a 假化 chart still needs full structural synthesis, it is simply not a special-structure chart

NODES.QUESTION: What is this chart's special-structure status: NONE_DETECTED / CANDIDATE / HIGH_CONFIDENCE / DISPUTED / INSUFFICIENT?
REQUIRED_INFERENCES: compound test (policy P2, REPAIRED at S3_CASE_REPLAY repair pass 1): HIGH_CONFIDENCE requires oneSidednessDetected=true AND governingRootSurvives=false AND (no outlet counterevidence found) AND an additional capitulation conjunct — either (a) AX03_fact shows a genuinely complete branch alliance (方合/三合 with no missing leg) leaving zero elemental presence for the outnumbered party in ANY position including hidden stems, or (b) a transformation-glyph activation from SPECIAL-03 independently confirms TRUE_TRANSFORMATION; oneSidednessDetected=true WITHOUT this additional conjunct (i.e. merely extreme season+numerousness, no complete alliance and no confirmed transformation) resolves to CANDIDATE, and a CANDIDATE with no positive capitulation evidence is RULED OUT at SV-01 (ordinary strength computation proceeds; the chart may still land on an EXTREME_* strength-view classification through the ordinary path, per DTS-SHUAIWANG-04/06/08/09/10/12/13/14 and DTS-GANGROU-01/02, all of which use 旺極/衰極 degree language without a stated capitulation and are tagged ORDINARY_STRENGTH, not SPECIAL_PATTERN, in the corpus); NONE_DETECTED requires oneSidednessDetected=false. POSITIVE_CONDITIONS: see REQUIRED_INFERENCES — this node has no single positive condition by design, it aggregates four prior signals through the named compound test, never a numeric threshold
COUNTEREVIDENCE: a documented cross-lineage scope split (temporal, question-domain) would downgrade an apparent DISPUTED back to CANDIDATE with a school-scoped note — none found in the replay pool
